assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached transparent PNG of the cheerful 3D delivery courier on a red scooter. Make ONE tightly constrained color revision: recolor all red painted scooter body panels, red mirrors, red delivery box, red helmet and red polo shirt to a harmonious fresh LEAF GREEN and OLIVE GREEN palette, matching a food delivery app whose palette is dark olive #35541D, leaf green #5D8C2B and lime accents #91C83D. Keep the exact same character identity, face, smile, waving hand, riding pose, silhouette, framing, scooter geometry, wheel positions, 3D materials, lighting and shadows. Keep ivory trim and sneakers ivory, trousers charcoal, skin tone unchanged, tyres and seat black, metal unchanged. Preserve all details and proportions. Only change the red branding surfaces to green; no redesign, no additional objects, no text, no logo, no watermark. Maintain the original full transparent alpha background and transparent margins; do not add a colored, white, or checkerboard backdrop. The result is the same reusable hero asset, now green.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one carefully aligned FOOD SPRITE ATLAS texture for a Flutter food delivery UI, a single wide 3:2 transparent PNG. Design exactly SIX delicious stylized 3D food icons in a precise 3-column by 2-row rectangular grid. Each cell is square and each food is wholly contained within the middle 70% of its own cell, with generous uniform transparent gutters; no cell borders. Exact cell order: TOP LEFT a tall cheeseburger with sesame bun, beef patty, cheddar, lettuce and tomato; TOP MIDDLE one triangular pepperoni pizza slice with melted cheese; TOP RIGHT golden french fries in an unbranded red paper carton. BOTTOM LEFT a small set of three salmon sushi maki rolls with one pair of chopsticks; BOTTOM MIDDLE a clear cup of iced orange drink with plain lid and straw, no brand; BOTTOM RIGHT two golden crispy chicken drumsticks together. Keep all six icons a consistent premium toy-like 3D app illustration style: rounded forms, appetizing realistic materials simplified into bold readable shapes, soft studio lighting, clean silhouettes. Use a consistent three-quarter viewing angle. Balance their sizes optically, each icon centered precisely in its equal sized cell. The image will be used as a single atlas with the Flutter code selecting each grid cell, so objects must never cross a cell boundary. No plates, no shared table, no arrangement as a meal, no large cast shadows, no tiny side garnishes, no lettering, no numerals, no labels, no watermark, no logo. Real alpha transparency throughout background and gutters. No white background or checkerboard painted into the image. Wide composition ideally 1536 by 1024 pixels, exactly 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows.

notes: Dois recursos finais. Entregador convertido para verde por edição integrada image_gen; atlas de alimentos reutilizado. Alpha preservado.

previous_courier.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one reusable transparent hero illustration for a polished Flutter food delivery app. Create a single friendly adult male delivery courier riding a RED scooter, a premium playful 3D clay illustration with rounded geometry, soft studio lighting, matte fabric and gently glossy scooter body. View: full body and full scooter, side three-quarter view facing RIGHT. He wears a cherry-red helmet with chin strap, red polo shirt, dark charcoal trousers, ivory sneakers, and carries a square red delivery box mounted behind the seat. Two anatomically coherent arms: right hand on handlebar, left hand lifted in a modest greeting; cheerful but understated face. Scooter ruby red with ivory accents, black tyres, both wheels fully visible. Main palette cherry red, burgundy, ivory, charcoal; NO green branding or green clothing. Center the isolated courier and scooter together inside a square canvas with generous 12 percent transparent margins so no part is cropped. Crisp readable silhouette at small mobile sizes, playful app onboarding illustration, not photorealistic. Only one courier and one scooter, no duplicates, no extra food, no road, no city, no ground plane, no banner, no letters, no logo, no watermark. Actual alpha transparent background, not a white or checkerboard background. Minimal soft contact shadow only.
